name: websyncterm
description: WebSyncTERM - a browser-based SyncTERM-compatible BBS terminal and self-hostable ftelnet-style gateway

scripts.build: node tools/sync-font-assets.mjs && node tools/check-clean.mjs && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" run build && pnpm --filter @websyncterm/gateway run build && pnpm --filter @websyncterm/embed run build && pnpm --filter @websyncterm/web run build
scripts.typecheck:apps: pnpm --filter @websyncterm/web exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @websyncterm/embed exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @websyncterm/gateway exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
